speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. Have you and Abel finished dividing it?

speaker: john_heminges
text: The basket is tied for Holywell at nine. I have been through the book with Garnish. You've written four ladies and a dairymaid, and I have three boys, and one of the three is the page.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Kemp has already seen her. She stays.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then Maria and Katharine. Where do you find two more, if one of the three is the page?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Out of Pope's parish. Two boys, hired by the week, three shillings each, to stand as Maria and Katharine. Not paid tonight. And Sincler, in black, for the messenger, since he needs no padding to look like bad news.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sincler will look like the news before he speaks it. Who takes the schoolmaster?

speaker: john_heminges
text: My wife says Nick is growing through his sleeves. The Princess wants a gown. I am not taking either trouble to Cheapside tonight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the gown. Nine of the clock, and the book from my mouth before a roll is loved for its own sake.
